correctness.rationale: For generic U the tetrahedral K4 projection has one proper disjoint-edge intersection exactly for a two-positive/two-negative affine dependence, equivalent to max |u_i| > sum of other |u|; otherwise none. The projected octahedral graph has four generic determinant-sign chambers with proper crossing counts 2,2,2,6 and cube has six such chambers each with 2 crossings; all parallelotopes reduce affinely to cube. These exhaustive open chambers and determinant sign invariance, not random samples, establish the pointwise coupling N_C=2 and N_O=6-4 N_T. Integrating 24 congruent spherical triangles yields p=(12/pi) arctan(3-2sqrt(2)). Independent vector-projection intersection calculation tested 5000 Gaussian sphere directions with counts 3334 for (1,2,2) and 1666 for (0,2,6), and no pointwise mismatches. Actual verify_wireframe.py symbolic determinant/chamber certificate was read; finite sampling alone is not an all-directions proof.
